applicabilityBasis.summary: TBILL contractually represents an investor economic interest in a pooled BVI professional fund and a proportional legal claim on its net asset redemption value. The issuer docs and platform name the fund and describe NAV-per-token pricing and whitelisted subscriptions/transfers. These fund-interest rights support the GENIUS section 2(22)(B)(iii) securities exclusion independently of reserve assets or yield alone.

references.label: OpenEden TBILL introduction: BVI Registered Professional Fund structure
GENIUS Act Public Law 119-27, payment stablecoin definition

genius.notes: TBILL is a tokenized fund interest issued by Treasury Bills Institutional Liquidity Limited, a BVI professional fund. The live platform confirms that legal issuer; issuer docs identify BNY Mellon Investment Management Singapore Pte. Limited as investment manager and BNY as custodian. Subscription/redemption and legal economic rights are NAV-based and whitelist-gated. Public fund-asset/NAV disclosure and a NAV redemption policy are present. The redemptionPolicyPresent field remains false because the tracker defines it as a public 1:1 redemption policy, which the fund does not offer. Fund-administrator daily/monthly NAV reports and the EY processes/controls review are not monthly independent stablecoin reserve attestations. GENIUS payment-stablecoin authorization posture is not applicable to this fund security. A 2026-10-07 public search for OpenEden/TBILL SEC, CFTC and OFAC enforcement did not locate an action naming this token or issuer; this is not regulatory clearance or a statement about nonpublic investigations.
